title: Natural kernel identifications from multiplication triangles
statement: In an abelian category A with derived category, let F:A→D(A) be fully faithful and U:B→A a functor. Fix H:N^op→B, M∈A, R:N^op→A, P_n∈A, isomorphisms r_n:R_n≅P_n, monomorphisms i_n:P_n→M, and transitions of the inclusions with multiplier ell. Suppose distinguished triangles with common first arrow m_n:X→X have second arrows alpha_n:X→F(UH_n) and q_n:X→F(P_n), and last arrows F(d_n) followed by a fixed shift comparison c:F(M)≅X[1] and F(-i_n) followed by c. Suppose the d_n have the same multiplier-ell transitions. Then there are a natural isomorphism roots:H⋙U≅R and isomorphisms a_n:UH_n≅P_n such that roots_n followed by r_n is a_n and alpha_n followed by F(a_n) is q_n.

source.place: Step (3), common kernel and natural transitions, and step (4), fixed second arrow and sign.

proof.text: Use Mathlib isoTriangleOfIso12 with identity isomorphisms on the first two objects. Apply F.preimageIso to the third component. The second and third triangle squares, functor faithfulness, and cancellation of c yield alpha_n followed by F(a_n)=q_n and a_n followed by i_n=-d_n.

Set e_n=a_n followed by inverse r_n. Its composite with the lower root inclusion is -d_n. The two transition hypotheses imply successor naturality after postcomposing by the lower inclusion; that inclusion is mono, so cancel it. NatTrans.ofOpSequence constructs the transformation on the whole inverse system, and invertible components make it a natural isomorphism. Its component formula yields roots_n followed by r_n=a_n. All reassociations use Category.assoc explicitly.

theorem pure_kernel_triangle_comparison
    {A B : Type*} [Category A] [Abelian A] [HasDerivedCategory.{w} A] [Category B]
    (U : B ⥤ A) (H : ℕᵒᵖ ⥤ B) (M : A) (R : ℕᵒᵖ ⥤ A) (P : ℕ → A)
    (r : ∀ n, R.obj (op n) ≅ P n) (i : ∀ n, P n ⟶ M) (hi : ∀ n, Mono (i n))
    (ℓ : ℕ)
    (hrt : ∀ n, R.map (homOfLE (Nat.le_succ n)).op ≫ (r n).hom ≫ i n =
      (r (n + 1)).hom ≫ i (n + 1) ≫ (ℓ • 𝟙 M))
    (F : A ⥤ DerivedCategory A) [F.Full] [F.Faithful]
    (X : DerivedCategory A) (c : F.obj M ≅ X⟦(1 : ℤ)⟧)
    (m : ℕ → (X ⟶ X))
    (α : ∀ n, X ⟶ F.obj (U.obj (H.obj (op n))))
    (q : ∀ n, X ⟶ F.obj (P n)) (d : ∀ n, U.obj (H.obj (op n)) ⟶ M)
    (hd : ∀ n, Pretriangulated.Triangle.mk (m n) (α n) (F.map (d n) ≫ c.hom) ∈
      distTriang (DerivedCategory A))
    (hK : ∀ n, Pretriangulated.Triangle.mk (m n) (q n) (F.map (-i n) ≫ c.hom) ∈
      distTriang (DerivedCategory A))
    (hdt : ∀ n, U.map (H.map (homOfLE (Nat.le_succ n)).op) ≫ d n =
      d (n + 1) ≫ (ℓ • 𝟙 M)) :
    ∃ (roots : H ⋙ U ≅ R) (a : ∀ n, U.obj (H.obj (op n)) ≅ P n),
      (∀ n, roots.hom.app (op n) ≫ (r n).hom = (a n).hom) ∧
      ∀ n, α n ≫ F.map (a n).hom = q n
